The 2026 Hanno Festival will take place over two days, November 7–8 (Reiwa 8).

This festival blends traditional events—floats, food stalls, neighborhood music performances, and lion dances—with a citizens' parade, vendor booths, and various attractions. Local residents and tourists gather to celebrate together.

Venue: Around Hanno Station North Exit (Odori Street, Ginza Street, Chuo Street, and others)

Rain or shine; cancelled only in severe weather. Event details may change on either day.

For details, visit Okumushi Hanno Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e4%bb%a4%e5%92%8c8%e5%b9%b4%e9%a3%af%e8%83%bd%e3%81%be%e3%81%a4%e3%82%8a%e3%80%8011-7%e5%9c%9f%ef%bd%a58%e6%97%a5
